audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..4].side all read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Azir, Swain, Skill, Skill, Swain. Three of those rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Content and packet agree exactly, and the kit supports the shape: Azir owns level 1 (Swain has one ability), Swain takes level 2-3 once Death's Hand stacks bolts and Nevermove is up, 4-5 is a genuine skillshot stage, and level 6 is his single biggest spike because Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s that lasts as long as he keeps draining.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Azir, phases[1].side -> Swain, phases[4].side -> Swain; phases[2] and [3] left on 'Skill' because they already match. Each moved row's .why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Swain timing, and content spikes[0].text put 'the drain damage on his Ultimate' at level 3.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a level 6 ability — flat 120s, 650 radius, indefinite while he keeps draining champions, and it shortens Nevermove's cooldown while active. Azir's spikes are Nashor's Tooth and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s). The item spike that actually matters here is Grievous Wounds, because Ravenous Flock heals him and permanently raises his max health.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now names Grievous Wounds; spikes[0].text no longer places the ultimate at level 3; phases[4].why carries the flat 120s and the drain's duration.

audit.whatIsWrong: A fabricated ability name shipped here: the content layer repeatedly names 'Torment' as a Swain ability, and mis-assigns slots — 'Vision-into-Torment (W-Q)' and wants.foe[0] 'Land Vision of Empire (Q) into Torment (W)'. Swain has no ability called Torment, Vision of Empire is his W not his Q, and spikes[1].text says W roots when W slows and reveals.
audit.why: Per the kit: Q Death's Hand (750, 7s to 3s, bolts that stack damage per bolt), W Vision of Empire (5500-7500, 22s to 18s, damage + slow + reveal + a Soul Fragment), E Nevermove (850, 12s to 10s — a wave that goes out, roots on the RETURN, then lets him pull the rooted target in), R Demonic Ascension. The root is E, and it roots on the way back — that is the single most useful timing fact in the matchup and the page never had it.
audit.corrected: 'Torment' removed everywhere; the return-pass root written into tldr, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[1].why and the content whys/spikes; wants.foe[0] re-slotted to Nevermove (E) into Death's Hand (Q).

audit.whatIsWrong: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT on breakdown.cooldowns; the packet also reports 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' with sequencingCues: 0; and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Nevermove 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Death's Hand 7/6/5/4/3, Vision of Empire 22/21/20/19/18, Demonic Ascension a flat 120 — nothing in the kit is fifteen seconds.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries real numbers plus the concrete sequencing line (wait Nevermove out before stepping to 740); the fabricated fifteen seconds is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under a warding title.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the 750/850 range band, and with what Vision of Empire's reveal does to a blind shove past river.

notes: CHART: phases[0..4].side all read the stale token 'Skill'; content win[] and packet.levelChart agree exactly on Azir, Swain, Skill, Skill, Swain, Azir, Azir, so I moved [0] to Azir, [1] and [4] to Swain and left [2]/[3] on Skill because they already matched. The packet's suspectNames flagged wants.foe[0] and it was a TRUE positive. Also removed an invented 'fifteen-second invitation' on Demonic Ascension, which is a flat 120s. Riot's own description of Ravenous Flock only says the ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health — nothing about ignoring armour or MR. Per the brief's rule that the description beats a derived flag, I wrote only the anti-heal half (Grievous Wounds) and left the resistances claim out.
